basic-event: SELECT * FROM events WHERE qid = 28250080 AND username = 'admin'
network-port: SELECT sourceip, destinationip FROM events WHERE destinationport BETWEEN 1 AND 1024
case-insensitive: SELECT * FROM events WHERE username ILIKE '%admin%'
threshold: SELECT sourceip, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM events WHERE qid = 1 GROUP BY sourceip HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
distinct: SELECT DISTINCT sourceip FROM events WHERE qid = 1
ordering: SELECT sourceip, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM events WHERE qid = 1 GROUP BY sourceip ORDER BY hits DESC
not-equal: SELECT * FROM events WHERE qid <> 0 AND username != 'guest'
in-list: SELECT * FROM events WHERE qid IN (1, 2, 3)
between-range: SELECT * FROM events WHERE destinationport BETWEEN 443 AND 8443
or-branch: SELECT * FROM events WHERE username = 'admin' OR username = 'root'
is-null: SELECT * FROM events WHERE ISNULL(username) = true
is-not-null: SELECT * FROM events WHERE ISNOTNULL(username) = true
like-prefix: SELECT * FROM events WHERE username LIKE 'svc%'
select-alias: SELECT sourceip AS source, username AS account FROM events WHERE qid = 1
incidr-function: SELECT sourceip FROM events WHERE INCIDR('10.0.0.0/8', sourceip)
matches-function: SELECT * FROM events WHERE payload MATCHES 'a.*b'
imatches-function: SELECT * FROM events WHERE payload IMATCHES 'a.*b'
last-hours: SELECT * FROM events WHERE qid = 1 LAST 2 HOURS
last-minutes: SELECT * FROM events WHERE qid = 1 LAST 30 MINUTES
start-stop: SELECT * FROM events WHERE qid = 1 START '2024-01-01 00:00' STOP '2024-01-02 00:00'
order-ascending: SELECT sourceip FROM events WHERE qid = 1 ORDER BY sourceip ASC
limited-results: SELECT sourceip FROM events WHERE qid = 1 LIMIT 25
group-only: SELECT sourceip FROM events GROUP BY sourceip
count-field: SELECT sourceip, COUNT(username) AS attempts FROM events GROUP BY sourceip
count-rows: SELECT sourceip, COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM events GROUP BY sourceip
unique-count: SELECT sourceip, UNIQUECOUNT(username) AS users FROM events GROUP BY sourceip
count-distinct: SELECT sourceip, COUNT(DISTINCT username) AS users FROM events GROUP BY sourceip
sum-measure: SELECT sourceip, SUM(bytes) AS total_bytes FROM events GROUP BY sourceip
avg-measure: SELECT sourceip, AVG(duration) AS mean_duration FROM events GROUP BY sourceip
average-measure: SELECT sourceip, AVERAGE(duration) AS mean_duration FROM events GROUP BY sourceip
min-measure: SELECT sourceip, MIN(duration) AS first_seen FROM events GROUP BY sourceip
max-measure: SELECT sourceip, MAX(duration) AS last_seen FROM events GROUP BY sourceip
first-measure: SELECT sourceip, FIRST(username) AS first_user FROM events GROUP BY sourceip
last-measure: SELECT sourceip, LAST(username) AS last_user FROM events GROUP BY sourceip
having-count: SELECT sourceip, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM events GROUP BY sourceip HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
having-unique: SELECT sourceip, UNIQUECOUNT(username) AS users FROM events GROUP BY sourceip HAVING UNIQUECOUNT(username) >= 3
having-sum: SELECT sourceip, SUM(bytes) AS total_bytes FROM events GROUP BY sourceip HAVING SUM(bytes) > 1000
having-average: SELECT sourceip, AVG(duration) AS mean_duration FROM events GROUP BY sourceip HAVING AVG(duration) >= 30
having-min: SELECT sourceip, MIN(duration) AS first_seen FROM events GROUP BY sourceip HAVING MIN(duration) > 0
having-max: SELECT sourceip, MAX(duration) AS last_seen FROM events GROUP BY sourceip HAVING MAX(duration) < 10000
aggregate-order-limit: SELECT sourceip, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM events GROUP BY sourceip ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT 10
aggregate-time-range: SELECT sourceip, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM events GROUP BY sourceip LAST 24 HOURS
distinct-fields: SELECT DISTINCT sourceip, username FROM events WHERE qid = 1
where-imatches: SELECT * FROM events WHERE username IMATCHES 'adm.*'
